rows.en: Everything is as Father wishes...!
I'll defeat you myself, with my own hands!
Bow down before the Machine Empire Gulfer!!
With Brother gone, I'm the one who'll defeat you!!
I'll take you all down with my own hands!!
I am the rightful heir to the Machine Empire Gulfer!
Dendohhhhh!!
Wicked people who defy Father...!
Humans... I'll wipe them out myself!!
In Brother's place, I'll take you all down!!
No... Why...?
I see... No one... ever... me...
rows.notes: Defeat line, trails off; kept unfinished as in source.
uncertain: Trailing line; the missing verb is left unsaid as in the source (likely 'no one needed me').

rows.en: I'm... Gulfer's...!!
rows.notes: Defeat line, cut off mid-claim; kept unfinished.
uncertain: Trailing fragment 'I am Gulfer's...' kept unfinished (likely 'prince').

rows.en: There's no way this can be happening!!
Uwaaah! Z-Zerooooo!!
I'm going down!? Me!?
Is this... Dendoh's power...!?
Why would I lose to someone like that...!
Dammiiiit!!
Why won't anything go the way I want!!
But Ogre belongs to me!!
M-me, beaten by Dendoh of all things...!!
Don't you mock me!!
Not to powerless trash like you!
rows.notes: Defiant: he won't be beaten by the weak.

rows.en: Obey me! Don't you talk back to me!
Don't... Don't you dare defy me!!
Damn you, Dendoh...!!
That won't hit me!
I can dodge that!
I may not be Brother's equal, but still!
I should be able to do it too!
Did you see that, Zero!?
That won't work on a Gulfer Machine Knight!
Protect me!!
It's useless!
rows.notes: Shared with Hugo Medio and a generic set; neutral wording.

rows.en: You think this can bring me down!?
What!? Why can't I fire!?
Ngh, don't I have any other weapon...!
Ngh! I won't forgive you... Never!
I'm the one who'll defeat this one!!
I'm going...!!
You needn't tell me!!
What are you doing!?
Go!!
rows.notes: Shared with Gigano soldiers.

rows.en: Beat that one down!!
rows.notes: Order to allies; target ungendered.

rows.en: Hurry up and finish it!
Hmph!
rows.notes: Shared with Masayoshi Kuki.

rows.en: Foolish, puny humans...!
Vermin swarming over the trees and grass...!
Everything is as His Majesty the Emperor wills...!
Now then, shall we begin...!
Hmph!!
Their will may be strong, but they are so fragile... Humans, that is...!!
We of Gulfer have no intention of repeating the same mistake!
Heh... Foolish, feeble humans!!
Nuoooooh!!
Wicked people who defy His Majesty!!
Heh, how fleeting... No, merely fragile...!
It's high time I laid you to rest... Altair
That's quite enough... Altair!
Hmph... So that one is no longer of use either...!
rows.notes: Possibly said of a disabled weapon or a fallen subordinate.
uncertain: Referent of 'that' (are mo) unclear: a weapon, a unit or an ally; kept as 'that one'.

rows.en: What are you doing? You, who once belonged to Gulfer...!
rows.notes: Aimed at Altair, who defected from Gulfer.

rows.en: Well, well, the ghosts of Alktos...!
Shatter, Dendoh!!
It seems this is the end... Dendoh!
That's far enough, Ogre!!
Hmph, Ogre, is it...!
Even with the Phoenix in hand! I won't let you through!!
rows.notes: Phoenix = the Phoenix Alae data weapon.

rows.en: Even with the seventh Data Weapon, I will not lose!!
rows.notes: Source says just 'the seventh one'; 'Data Weapon' added for clarity.
uncertain: 'Seventh one' read as the seventh Data Weapon (Leo Circle).

rows.en: I'll settle this soon... all of it...!
I'm afraid that's as far as you go!
How persistent you are...!
Gulfer, beaten by mere humans like you!?
Hmph! Allow me to finish this quickly!
How persistent you are! Dendoh!
Allow me to finish you! Ogre!
Impossible... Uoooooh!!
Guaaaaaah!!
Nuoooooooh!!
Hmph... It seems little time remains...
You cannot defeat me, you see... Never...!
I will not lose!! I shall never lose!!
No matter how you struggle, you cannot defeat me...!!
Do you truly think you can defeat me?
At this rate, I won't hold out much longer...
Dendoh...! I never imagined you were this strong...!
To think Ogre had this much power...!
You do make things troublesome... Truly...!
Ngh, uuuuugh...!!
Heh! A clever trick!!
Ngh! The likes of you!!
Not bad, for a human
This has become a little troublesome...!
Damn you, Dendoh!!
Ngh, a mere Ogre...!!
Heh, such futile struggling...!
Impudent...!
Such a racket is quite an eyesore
No matter how many feeble humans band together!
Why not just give up already?
Are you satisfied now?
You're no match at all, Dendoh!
Is this all the legendary GEAR amounts to...?
Hmph! Such futile resistance...!
There!!
Heh...
Heh heh heh... Where were you looking?
Human after all... Doing something so pointless
You cannot even break through a shield like this?
Missiles are meaningless against me, you see
Surely you've had your fill by now
It seems you have no energy left
Hm... This was not part of the plan...
Hmph...! A cowardly trick...!
So humans aren't quite that foolish after all...
It seems I can't reach from here
Hmph! So you're still alive after all...
rows.notes: Said after failing to finish a target.
uncertain: Read as addressed to the target ('you'); source has no subject and could be third person.

rows.en: If the first move fails, then on to the next
It seems this is the end!
Why do you hesitate!?
rows.notes: Polite, likely to Subaru (support/command line).

rows.en: Lord Subaru... leave this to me
I can't have you dying just yet...
A finite life... such a nuisance
It won't do for you to act this way, my lord
Please stand back, Lord Subaru
Make this place the wretch's grave!!
rows.notes: Order to allies; target ungendered.

rows.en: Go! Bury the wretch in one stroke!
I shall put an end to everything...!
It seems your luck has run out
Water, wind, light and earth! I rule over them all!!
Humans, who cannot even live without me!!
I am king of this planet! No, king of the whole universe!!
This is the end!! Altair!!
Dendoh! This finishes you!!
You shall not pass, Dendoh!!
I won't let you go any further!!
Humans!!
To you... to the likes of you!!
I cannot be defeated! I cannot be defeated!!
I cannot be defeated!! That is what I was made to be!!
Graah...! By you... by the likes of you...!!
Nngh... the likes of Altair......!!
That has no effect on meee!!
Why, you!
rows.notes: Shared with Quattro, Fa, Iino, Beecha, Rain: neutral wording.

rows.en: I believe... in the power of people!
I'll put an end to this!
For now... I just keep moving forward!
I'll show you! The strength of people's... feelings!
Altairrrr!!
Knight Ogre......!
rows.notes: Knight Ogre = Altair's unit; title not in glossary as a phrase.

rows.en: Humanity will never bow to Gulfer!
I won't hand Earth over to you Gulfer!
That's enough out of you!
If there's even the slightest chance...!
Here's payback!!
I-I can't afford to go down here!
I can't end here... I'll protect those kids!
Maybe it really is time to pull out...!
Not a chance! Let's show them GEAR's grit!
rows.notes: Vega set; several crew share it.
uncertain: Crew line in Vega's set; speaker inferred as a GEAR crew member.

rows.en: Vice Commander! Are you all right!?
rows.notes: Vega set; several crew share it.
uncertain: 'Vice Commander' assumed to be Vega's title as addressed by her crew.

rows.en: Maybe it really is time to pull out...!
Ms. Vega!!
rows.notes: Vega set; several crew share it. Crew member calls her by name.

rows.en: Damn!? It hit us dead on!?
Not yet! Not from something like this!
What speed...!
Ugh...! Impressive...!
Vice Commander, what do we do...!?
rows.notes: Vega set; several crew share it.

rows.en: Damn, isn't there anything that works...!
Vice Commander! Thruster nozzle pressure is dropping!
rows.notes: Vega set; several crew share it.

rows.en: You're right, we're in trouble at this rate...!
Charging out recklessly is the same as admitting defeat!
Oh, nooo......!
Did I blow it!?
This is nothing!!
rows.notes: Shared with Werner Fritz.

rows.en: Ngh! I reacted too late...!
All systems green, we can still keep going!
No need to worry! It's just a scratch!
Damage is minor! Vice Commander, prepare to counter!
Did we get hit!? Run a check, please!
Unit status: no abnormalities detected
I'll dodge it!
Not with that!
rows.notes: Shared with Kazuya Ryuzaki.

rows.en: That won't hit me!
Too slow!
Nicely done!
That was a bit close, wasn't it...?
Too bad for you!
rows.notes: Shared with Haruka Shito.

rows.en: That's useless!
Shield!
rows.notes: Shared with Aqua Centrum and a generic set.

rows.en: I won't let you!!
If we use the jammer!
Over here!
We're burning through more than I expected...!
They got into my blind spot...!?

rows.notes: Shared with Hari Makibi, Argo Gulski.

rows.en: Leave this to me!
rows.notes: Shared with Aqua Centrum and a generic set.

rows.en: We need to shake them up more!
I can still keep going!!
Brother, leave the rest to me!
rows.notes: Support line addressing her older brother.
uncertain: Vega's set has lines to an 'aniue' (elder brother); who this is was not verified (Altair is a guess). Rendered 'Brother'.

rows.en: Ginga, I'll help you out!
Eris, I'll help you out!
We're attacking from this side too! Kirakuni!
We can still keep going! Hokuto!
Leave the rest to me! Subaru!
Hokuto, Ginga! Leave the rest to me!
Recklessness and courage are two different things!
Don't charge ahead carelessly!
Please, make it in time!
Look out! Brother!!
rows.notes: Same elder-brother reference as q02546.

rows.en: Ginga, fall back!
Eris, fall back!
You'll get hit, Kirakuni!
Hokuto, look out!!
Subaru, now's your chance!
Don't do anything reckless, you two!
I'm making my move! Support me, please!
Even a little power, if we stand united...!
rows.notes: Trails off like the source.

rows.en: I'll show you! The power of our feelings!
Leave this side to me!
I've got your support covered!
Have this!
rows.notes: Attack line (literally 'receive this').

rows.en: Go down!
rows.notes: Shared with many pilots; neutral wording.

rows.en: Take this!
rows.notes: Shared with Aqua Centrum and a generic set.

rows.en: Enemy approaching...! Ms. Vega!
rows.notes: Crew line in Vega's set.

rows.en: To the left! Ms. Vega!
rows.notes: Crew line in Vega's set.

rows.en: Beam Cannon at maximum output
Have this, then!!
Deeeeyaaah!!
Teyah!!
Seyaaah!!
Haaaaaah!!
To defy us of Gulfer... how foolish
I shall show you my power
I'll commend you for coming this far
I shall destroy you here...!
Curse you, Dendoh!
Will you defy me to the bitter end...!
Endlessly... endlessly detestable...!
Vanish before my power...!
I shall make you pay for this
I have no use for the powerless
Curse you... curse you all...!
Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor... forgive... me...
C-curse you... I won't forgive this!
I won't fall so easily... I will not fall!
This won't end like this... It will not end!
That you would have this much power...!
Dendoh! If I die... you die with me!
Ogre! Even if my life ends, I'm taking you with me!
I'm not finished yet...!
You're fairly capable...
Nnngh... I cannot face His Majesty the Emperor...
It seems you are worthy to fight...
Nn... Dendoh... so it is you after all...!
Ogre, this power... what is it...!
What's wrong? Is that all you've got?
Laughable...
You hit me... and that is all
Anyone can merely land a hit
Very well... I shall at least humor you
Don't make me laugh...
Nuhahaha... What's the matter...?
Did you truly think that would hit...?
That could never work...
Mere lowly humans after all... Is that all?
What... I have no... energy!?
My power... my power falls short!?
Such an attack is possible...?
Impossible... I refuse to accept it!
To make such futile moves before my very eyes
I won't let you do as you please before my eyes
Keep the enemy away!
I shall shoot you down...!
You're the enemy... my enemy!!
rows.notes: Brainwashed Hokuto fighting for Gulfer.

rows.en: Subaru, watch me...!
Waaah!! Zero, Subaru...!
There's no way we Gulfer can lose...!
Kuuuuuugh...!!
Not yet! Ogre!!
That won't work on me!
You always rely on brute force, don't you!
rows.notes: Aimed at Ginga.

rows.en: I saw through your kenpo long ago!!
Gale Triple Strike!!
I'm going all out~!
Okaaay, hold still now~
Shooting you dowwwn!
No need to return the favor~
I'm out of practice, but I won't lose!
Come on, come on, you'll be sorry if you don't watch closely~?
Just when I thought things had gone quiet...!
You guys are so persistent!
Welll then... time to return the favor!
Now I'm really mad!
Not done yet, we're just getting started!
Keep the change~!
I've gotta thank you properly!
Now it's my turn!
Always do your payback and your inking properly!
rows.notes: Manga-artist joke (pen inking).

rows.en: B-bailing out~! Ryoko, don't be mad, 'kay!?
Waaah! Ryokooo! This is bad!
Oh no! Ugh, I'm way too out of practice!
W-well then, I think I'll just excuse myself here...
This is starting to feel like my series is getting canceled!?
If I go down here, I'll miss next week's deadline!
Ugh! I might drop a deadline, but I won't drop out of the sky!
rows.notes: Pun on 'otosu/ochiru' (miss a deadline / be shot down).

rows.en: A c-coup... w-well, good luck with that
rows.notes: Aimed at the Martian Successors' coup.

rows.en: Whoa! This one isn't just creepy!
rows.notes: Enemy ungendered ('this one').

rows.en: Hey! Go easy on me!
This is when I really feel how rusty I am...
Is the Field kinda not doing anything?
Not yet! We're only around the middle of the series!
You've gotta get into a little pinch now and then!
Whoa there! No wonder you're the ones pulling a coup!
Feels like you're just toying with me. So annoying!
Uh-oh... the Field didn't work?
Ow ow! Geez! What do you think you're doing!?
It grazed me! ...Maybe I've gotten rusty
Sorry, my little Aesti. I got you all scratched up
rows.notes: Affectionate '-chan' pet name for the Aestivalis rendered 'my little Aesti'.

rows.en: Damage check... you can still move, right!?
Sigh, I sure don't want to get old...
Wouldn't you be better off dropping this coup thing?
Ugh, what a nasty feeling!
This is way easier than storyboarding!
Easier than laying screentone, easy-peasy!
Not half as tedious as filling in blacks~!
My editor is way scarier than this!
Hup! Hop! There, dodge, dodge~
Whoa! Hey! What if that had hit me!?
My old Aesti might not have dodged that, huh?
My Aesti's got great performance these days!
This one's scary! Heaven protect me...
rows.notes: 'Kuwabara kuwabara' charm rendered as 'Heaven protect me'.

rows.en: That won't work on me, I'm telling you!
My Field will just bounce it off!
Distortion Field!
Handy as ever, my dear Field!
Huh!? Out of ammo!?
Letting them get distance on me... must be the rust
Whoa whoa! ...Isn't the plot taking a bad turn?
Covering fire, comin' up~!
Come on, come on, outta the way~
Ryoko's really fired up, huh!
Akito, I'll back you up!
Ruri-Ruri's gone and grown up so much...
Ruri-Ruri! Leave the rest to meee~!
Hey, Izumi! Move it!
Look ouuut!
When it counts, even I can get it done!
Fall back! I've got the Field over here!
Let's breeze right through~!
Blasting you awaaay!
Lock on! Mmm, that has a nostalgic ring!
It's a gun, so bang bang, down they go~!
rows.notes: Gun pun (ban-ban).

rows.en: This thing has way too much recoil~
Rail Cannon, fiiire!
rows.notes: Weapon in glossary is 'Large Rail Cannon'; line says just Rail Cannon.

rows.en: I'm gonna blow you awaaay!
Distortion Field, full power!
Aesti Puuunch~!
Let's do a head-on collision! Here I gooo~!
All right! Let's give it a go, it's been a while!
rows.notes: Triple-attack banter shared with Ryoko and Izumi. Speaker inferred: Ryoko.
uncertain: Shared triple-attack line; speaker inferred as Ryoko from tone.

rows.en: You're so young at heart, Ryoko
rows.notes: Triple-attack banter shared with Ryoko and Izumi. Speaker inferred: Hikaru, teasing.

rows.en: Acting young... a crime against time...
rows.notes: Triple-attack banter shared with Ryoko and Izumi. Izumi pun (tsumi-tsukuri / waka-zukuri); pun recreated rather than literal.
uncertain: Izumi wordplay recreated loosely; literal sense is 'acting young is a sinful thing'.

rows.en: Quit yapping and go!
rows.notes: Triple-attack banter shared with Ryoko and Izumi. Speaker inferred: Ryoko.

rows.en: Okay then, let's dooo it~!
rows.notes: Triple-attack banter shared with Ryoko and Izumi. Speaker inferred: Hikaru.

rows.en: Thanks for the meal~
rows.notes: Triple-attack banter shared with Ryoko and Izumi. Speaker inferred: Izumi.

rows.en: I said take this seriously! Ooraaah!
rows.notes: Triple-attack banter shared with Ryoko and Izumi. Speaker inferred: Ryoko, scolding Izumi.
